propositions: No aggregated lens exists to analyze 344 closed bugs across dimensions: close_class distribution, detection channel, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close percentiles; trend queries require ad-hoc scripts.
Pre-convention bugs lack close_class labels (circa 214 bugs) and must surface as an explicit labeled MISSING cohort rather than silently merging or dropping to avoid taxonomy-era skew.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within ctx range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, fan-in) are point-in-time measures over current store and deliberately ignore range semantics.
Sparse or entirely absent detected_by field must degrade that dimension to unavailable state without crashing or affecting other dimensions.
